name: BDKiPartSearchTools
description: Component search, symbol/footprint/3D model library importer, and smart priced BOM tool by Berkay Degirmenci.
description_full:
BDKiPartSearchTools (by Berkay Degirmenci) allows you to search electronic components from online suppliers (LCSC/EasyEDA, DigiKey, etc.) and import them directly into KiCad libraries (.kicad_sym, .kicad_mod, .step, .wrl) with automatic sym-lib-table and fp-lib-table registration.

Features:
- Live 2D Schematic Symbol and PCB Footprint preview before import
- Automatic category-based or unified library organization (Global or Project scope)
- Embeds full supplier and engineering metadata (MPN, Manufacturer, Supplier Part #, Unit Price, Stock, Datasheet) into symbols
- Smart BOM & Live Pricing/Stock manager supporting Engineering CSV, JLCPCB PCBA BOM, and DigiKey Bulk Upload CSV
- Accessible from both Schematic Editor (Eeschema) and PCB Editor (Pcbnew) in KiCad 9/10.
- Note: User interface is currently provided in Turkish.
